title: Council shared primitives
description: Identity, revision and provenance primitives shared by every Council record. Referenced from the other schemas; never instantiated on its own.

SchemaVersion.description: Wire/record format version. A reader that does not recognise the value refuses the record rather than guessing.

Id.description: Opaque stable identifier. Generated once by the owner of the record and never reused after deletion.

Revision.description: Monotonic revision counter owned by exactly one writer. A write carrying a revision that is not current is rejected, never merged.

ContentHash.description: Hash of the captured bytes a record was derived from. Equality proves the material has not drifted.

Timestamp.description: UTC, RFC 3339, Z-suffixed. Display formatting is a view concern.

MemberKind.description: What the participant IS. 'human' in v0.1 means the local user; imported third-party material is attributed source content, not a human member.

ClaimSupport.description: How a claim relates to the grounding: quoted/paraphrased from a cited source, an application of that thinking to this question, or a position the material does not establish.

PayloadRef.description: Content that may exceed the 64 KiB pluginIPC payload cap. Exactly one of 'inline' or 'blob_handle' is present; the hash and byte length describe the same bytes either way.

inline.description: The content itself. Only permitted when byte_length <= 32768.

blob_handle.description: Host blob handle; the bytes live in the editor blob store, out of band.

ArtifactRef.description: A pointer to a native Minerva artifact. 'missing' records that the target could not be resolved on the last attempt, which is a recoverable state and never a reason to drop the reference.
